observations: Buddy has a concrete independent objective: negotiate the cape without stepping on it. The at-home count, useful observation of Maximus, wide-turn rehearsal and deliberately slow entrance form a clear causal chain. Neet wants the spotlight; his half-step closer after dismissing Lady Puddington undercuts his pose without explaining the joke.

The held-paw illustration pauses on the exact shared stance after applause starts and before Buddy asks to lower his paw. The subsequent harder clapping escalates the trap, Heather releases him, and Neet holds a fraction longer. Attribution and dialogue order remain clear.

Neet is assured and theatrical; Buddy is practical, uncertain and dry; Heather is playful at fitting and reassuring on stage. Buddy remains an actor rather than only a commentator. The older Heather-centered household is retained without adding Sagar.

Preparation shows Buddy watching a lifted foot under a slightly tilted crown with cape behind him; Neet watches from his blue tuxedo. It occurs after Buddy stands and tries a second step, before Heather straightens the crown. Mirror and rug distinguish the home setting.

Runway shows distinct raised forepaws, separate supporting legs, an upright crown, a trailing cape, pavilion lights and red carpet; no trophy appears early. Smooth exposed coat regions are visible at intended reading size, consistent with closure of the prior finish finding.

Trophy shows Buddy bending to sniff the bone on its base while Neet poses on the joint podium. It follows the second sniff and precedes the inedible-bone remark and treat pouch. It does not preempt the treat reversal. The three pictures serve rehearsal, applause predicament and reward deflation, rather than repeating a portrait.
Across the pictures Neet keeps royal blue jacket and bow tie; Buddy keeps red cape with gold trim, red crown jewels and gold clasp. The corrected runway and trophy designs now read as one costume.

The warm ending gives Buddy a practical exit from royal attire while Neet keeps the bow tie. The trophy joke and shared distraction by treats puncture both fashion icons affectionately; no image crowds or spoils the final paragraph.

Opened rendered sheets against N19 N29 B04 B29. Neet fine legs/full torso/nub and Buddy substantial legs/elongated torso used provisionally. Old model coat marks are not finish authority; use max-art-v005 smooth planes.
